name: Ppyong
source: The most popular devil in the red lump family. Affiliated to Gehenna. He travels through dimensions for the sake of MC's health. He also enjoys being kicked by Satan. Ppyong also participates in group chats with the MC and helps Sitri explain the history and rules of Hell. Ppyong is also friends with the human Minhyeok, who often gives him sweets and asks him to deliver things to MC in Hell.
